common: CREATE TABLE inventory_storage_profile (id INTEGER NOT NULL, mode VARCHAR NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_inventory_storage_profile PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_storage_profile_singleton CHECK (id = 1), CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_storage_profile_mode CHECK (mode IN ('fts5','bounded_lexical')))

CREATE TABLE inventory_snapshot_payloads (snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, serialization_version VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, payload_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, payload_json JSON NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_inventory_snapshot_payloads PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inventory_snapshot_payloads_snapshot_id_inventory_snapshots FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id) REFERENCES inventory_snapshots (snapshot_id), CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_snapshot_payloads_serialization_version CHECK (typeof(serialization_version) = 'text' AND length(serialization_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(serialization_version)) > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_snapshot_payloads_payload_digest CHECK (typeof(payload_sha256) = 'text' AND length(payload_sha256) = 64 AND payload_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_snapshot_payloads_payload_object CHECK (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload_json) THEN json_type(payload_json) = 'object' ELSE 0 END))

CREATE TABLE inventory_search_documents (namespace VARCHAR NOT NULL, snapshot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, source_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, index_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, document_text VARCHAR NOT NULL, document_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_inventory_search_documents PRIMARY KEY (namespace, snapshot_id, source_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inventory_search_documents_namespace_snapshot_id_source_id_listing_versions FOREIGN KEY(namespace, snapshot_id, source_id) REFERENCES listing_versions (namespace, snapshot_id, source_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inventory_search_documents_snapshot_id_index_version_inventory_snapshots FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id, index_version) REFERENCES inventory_snapshots (snapshot_id, index_version), CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_search_documents_index_digest CHECK (typeof(index_version) = 'text' AND length(index_version) = 64 AND index_version NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_search_documents_document_digest CHECK (typeof(document_sha256) = 'text' AND length(document_sha256) = 64 AND document_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_search_documents_document_text CHECK (typeof(document_text) = 'text'))
